GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. shared lead turn under pressure. weakened # Every Chance
Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 3 Wide with cover 6 lengths. very Wide turn under pressure. battled away # Wide trip
Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 2 lengths. got to outside turn 2 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Overraced in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Touch slow away. Niggled to recover & raced well back on inside (7L from lead) early . Stayed same until pushed to quicken @ 500m. Pushed along on inside (7L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 300m & made slight ground late. Near side blinker first time / winkers off 1st time. # Fair 1st-up run.
Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 2 lengths. 2nd turn. ran on well # just too strong
Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 1 length. 2nd turn under pressure. weakened # pulled up lame
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that the horse travelled too keenly in the early and middle stages and, as a consequence, was unable to close off in the home straight. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding revealed the gelding to be lame (2/5) in the off foreleg. Trainer was advised that a veterinary clearance will be required before the gelding barrier trials or races again.VC received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok worked early to lead. shared lead turn under pressure. battled on well # Every Chance
Jumped Ok worked early to find lead. led 5 lengths mis race. led 4 lengths turn. weakened late # went too hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: App was spoken to and advised that in the middle stages of the race she should have made more effort to restrain her mount bearing in mind the very solid tempo that her mount was setting in the lead. Rider penalised for excessive whip use.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. looking for run turn 4 lengths. held up early in Straight . got to outside 300 metres. ran on well late # not best luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced in the early and middle stages due to the muddling tempo.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok trapped Wide early over racing before settling 4th 3 lengths. under pressure turn 4 lengths. hooked Wide in Straight . tan on strongly late. not much luck # very good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding her riding in the early stages, App rdr stated she was instructed to ride her mount forward. She initially settled behind another rnr, anticipating that rnr would go forward. She added that when that rnr did not go forward as expected and when her mount began to race keenly, she improved around rnrs to take up a more prominent position with cover, with the intention of allowing the gelding to settle and to comply with her instructions.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down last 10 lengths. well back turn. Held Ground # Not Sighted
